edition.title: This weekend on Keowee + Jocassee
edition.dek: Walhalla PAC's headline slot is back: Ashley McBryde plays the stage Friday night, the first big show since the summer wound down. Jazz on the Alley still owns Thursday downtown, the weekly Jocassee sunset run goes out Saturday evening, and both breweries keep their usual free Friday–Saturday music going — check their calendars for who's actually playing before you head out.

events.title: Jazz on the Alley
events.body: Seneca's Thursday-night institution — free live jazz on historic Ram Cat Alley, every week through October. The happy-hour set starts at 5:30, the main act at 6:30. Get dinner downtown and let the weekend start a day early.
events.note: Free · 6:30–9pm (happy hour 5:30) · Ram Cat Alley, downtown Seneca

events.title: Ashley McBryde at Walhalla PAC
events.body: The Performing Arts Center's headline slot returns after a quiet week: country singer-songwriter Ashley McBryde plays the room in downtown Walhalla. It's a small venue for a name this size — check with the box office on what's left.
events.note: 7:30pm · Walhalla Performing Arts Center · check the venue for remaining tickets & pricing

events.title: Sunset Lake Tour
events.body: A slower two-hour run out onto Jocassee as the light goes gold over the mountains, with a waterfall or two along the way. Runs every Saturday evening through the season; needs six bookings to go out, so reserve ahead.
events.note: $65 · 2 hours · every Saturday · Jocassee Lake Tours

events.title: Free live music at both breweries
events.body: Jocassee Valley Brewing in Salem and Keowee Brewing in Seneca both run their usual free Friday and Saturday night sets, with food trucks at Jocassee Valley. Neither had this week's lineup posted as of publish time — check each calendar for who's actually on before you go.
events.note: Free · Fri & Sat nights · lineups posted on each venue's own calendar

plan.title: Dinner, then Ashley McBryde at Walhalla PAC
plan.body: Grab dinner downtown before the show — Walhalla PAC's headline slot is back this week. No ticket? Keowee Brewing and Jocassee Valley Brewing both have their usual free Friday music going too.
plan.label: Find a spot to eat & drink →

plan.title: A ramp, a swim, then the sunset tour
plan.body: No headline event Saturday during the day — find a ramp, get on the water, then book the Jocassee sunset run for the evening. Both breweries run free music again that night.
plan.label: Find a ramp →

plan.title: Keep it slow, check the level
plan.body: Nothing dated is on the calendar for Sunday this week — pick a swim spot, check today's lake level, and make your own plan for the last day of the weekend.
plan.label: Pick a swim spot →
